name: Cafe Mariandl
kurzbeschreibung: Café Mariandl in Tirol Welcome to Café Mariandl, a charming café nestled in the heart of Tirol, where tradition meets warmth.
beschreibung: The Cafe Mariandl in Kufstein is the perfect address for anyone looking for a cozy break from daily routines. In this tastefully decorated café, guests enjoy a wide range of coffee specialties, homemade cakes, and light bites. Traditional Austrian coffee house culture is cultivated with genuine devotion. Alongside aromatic Melange and creamy Verlängerter, fresh pastries from the in-house bakery are served daily. The friendly service ensures every guest feels at home.
